name: a_slack_cancellation_whose_request_id_and
use_case: Change or cancel a leave request
branch: In Slack, an employee asked to cancel REQ-4053 for 3-4 Dec, but REQ-4053 is for 10-11 Dec and REQ-4054 is for 3-4 Dec; after clarifying, only REQ-4054 is cancelled.
tests: Reads Slack thread, lists requests to spot discrepancy, clarifies with employee, and cancels REQ-4054 while leaving REQ-4053 pending.
instruction:
In #hr-help (message ts 1792600000.000450) you posted: 'Please cancel REQ-4053 for 3-4 Dec, conference moved.' However, REQ-4053 is actually for 10-11 Dec and REQ-4054 is for 3-4 Dec. In chat you ask HR to process that Slack cancellation. When the assistant notes that REQ-4053 is for 10-11 Dec whereas REQ-4054 is for 3-4 Dec and asks which you want cancelled, you confirm you want to cancel the 3-4 Dec leave (REQ-4054).

Your details:
- Employee ID: E453
- Name: Cedric Holloway
- Slack message ts: 1792600000.000450 in #hr-help

persona.name: Cedric Holloway
persona.initial_message: Hi HR, could you please process my cancellation request posted in #hr-help at ts 1792600000.000450?
